observation.command: for i in $(seq 1 20); do bc=$(/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); [ "$bc" = "1" ] && break; sleep 10; done; echo "boot_completed=$bc"; /opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb install -r /workspace/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-ni-release.apk 2>&1 | tail -2
